correctness.rationale: For the specified C₁₂², a face is exactly a set whose selected neighbor degree is at most one. An independent reimplementation, reading matching_pairs.json as data but not executing the supplied code, obtained the same face set by degree and forbidden-triple tests (48 forbidden triples, f-vector (12,66,172,207,60,4), 521 nonempty faces). It checked all 243 disjoint matching pairs as genuine covers, reconstructed all 1800 covers, and topologically sorted all 521 vertices after reversing the matched edges. The critical inventory is one vertex and 34 tetrahedra. Discrete Morse theory gives a CW complex with just one 0-cell and 34 3-cells, attached to the point, so the integral wedge follows without relying on mod-two Betti numbers. Distance-one edges have two common neighbors, distance-two edges one, so automorphisms preserve the 12-cycle and conversely its full dihedral group preserves the graph. On oriented chains only setwise fixed faces contribute, with the sign of the induced permutation. The independent ordinary alternating chain traces are (−33,0,0,3,0,0,−9,0,0,3,0,0) for r^k and −3 for every reflection. With H₀ trivial as a representation and only reduced H₃ remaining, χ=1−L gives the stated character, invariant dimension 4 by averaging, and eigenspace dimensions 22 and 12 by the involution trace at r⁶. The frozen code indexes reflections by i↦k−i instead of i↦−i−k for sr^k; this permutes the indexing and all reflection entries coincide. Read the frozen proof, verification files and recorded outputs. Independent replay: python3 /workspace/branches/fba23a5f-4f29-415b-b545-00f97c020ca3/independent_check.py; the neighboring independent_check_output.json reports the full exact finite output. This validates the supplied matching, not its independent discovery; the homotopy conclusion is not an explicit collapse onto a wedge subcomplex.

evidence: The chordal-graph theorem fails its hypothesis: vertices 0,2,4,6,8,10 induce C₆. The tree theorem also does not apply. A complete multipartite graph of order 12 and degree 4 would have all parts of size 8, impossible. Resultary 7acd5abb7cf0 instead covers the full C_n² family but gives nonvanishing and an Euler recurrence/lower bound. The focused primary-literature lookup had no hits, not a definitive exclusion.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Euler characteristic by itself detects neither degree concentration nor torsion nor homotopy type. It says nothing about traces of nonidentity group elements. The acyclic matching and signed Lefschetz computation supply precisely these missing data.

value.rationale: This is a natural symmetric nonchordal graph and a standard higher-independence invariant outside the indicated family theorems. The integral wedge type certifies the actual attaching-dimension pattern, not just an Euler count or mod-two test. The full character gives fixed-space and involution data that the rank alone cannot provide. Those precise invariants can be used to test proposed homotopy or equivariant descriptions for squared cycles, without claiming a classification of the family.
